summary: Harden full-suite verification for fkst-packages-testing through package-level coverage, composed-flow coverage, and final suite stabilization.
applies_when: The origin asks to perform full testing, full verification, or full-suite coverage hardening for fkst-packages-testing. It is not for a one-off CI rerun, product-specific app testing, or a narrow single-package bugfix.

content.generator: Read the origin issue from its source_ref and inspect fkst-packages-testing at ground truth. Emit exactly one child issue title and body scoped to package-level verification: add or repair hermetic Lua tests, conformance coverage, and runner-script contract tests for the reusable testing packages. Keep the repository generic: do not add product-specific modules, fixed application URLs, ORNN-specific facts, credentials, cookies, or host-specific environment names. The child PR must run the relevant package tests and leave them green. If there is no executable package-level coverage gap, produce no changes with a clear WHY.

Read the origin issue and the MERGED package-contract-coverage result through source_ref. Emit exactly one child issue title and body scoped to closed-world composed-flow coverage for fkst-packages-testing: browser-readiness, testing-discovery, testing-pipeline, module-test-loop, platform-test-loop, testing-runner, test-artifacts, and test-publication integration seams. Use neutral fixtures and existing example hosts only. Do not encode product-specific module catalogs, browser roles, base URLs, credentials, or environment names. The child PR must keep scripts/run.sh check and scripts/run.sh test green. If no composed-flow coverage gap remains, produce no changes with a clear WHY.

Read the origin issue and the MERGED composed-testing-flow-coverage result through source_ref. Emit exactly one child issue title and body scoped to final full-suite stabilization: run the repository's full verification entrypoints, diagnose deterministic failures, and fix only failures or missing harness coverage exposed by the prior steps. Do not broaden scope, do not add product-specific fixtures, and do not create report-only artifacts. The child PR must provide evidence for scripts/run.sh check and scripts/run.sh test. If the full suite is already green and no code or test change is needed, produce no changes with a clear WHY.
